change: Only rebuildable PG atomic stage becomes UNLOGGED. Final target and ledger remain logged; all count/fingerprint/exact byte checks and one publication transaction retained. No MERGE or hash changes.
scope: Same PG atomic mode, not ordinary mode, other writers or all-scenario proof.
correctness: Real SIGKILL and restart of only datax-perf-postgres, three publication points, JDBC/COPY, four repeats; baseline logged stage controls too
Source and existing target byte equality across crash, no uncommitted target rows, committed target plus ledger survive, two same-ID retries
Expanded atomic, floating and previous-version same-ID recovery checks

performance.wal_metric: Server-wide WAL insert LSN delta immediately before/after each Engine run, sampled outside the timer; includes background WAL. Identical measurement on both variants.

retention: Every correctness assertion must pass. Each of three medians >=5%, every paired gain >=0. Final user +25/+50 gates evaluated separately.
storage: Existing one-million-row source and dedicated container; between-run 6 GiB budget guard, per-writer temp_file_limit=1536MB. No WAL or persistence-setting changes.
isolation: No builds/profiling/compression/other local tests during performance.
limits: UNLOGGED staging is truncated by database crash and not replicated; every retry already rebuilds it. Trial must prove failure/recovery rather than treat stage durability as given. Not production failover or hundred-million-row proof.
